ValidationRule.description: This rule is fired when value of status is not changed from "Assigned" and "New" to "Validated" .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , ISCHANGED( Status ) ,NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Assigned") ,ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "In Progress") , ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "New") )), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Validated") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Validated can be changed from Assigned, New and In Progress.
